title: RDD 血缘 DAG 的构建与打印
expected_output:
血缘 DAG（自下而上，缩进=父级依赖）:
        RDD#1 [parallelize 分区=4]
      RDD#2 [map x=>x*2]
    RDD#3 [filter x%2==0]
  RDD#4 [reduceByKey 宽依赖]
RDD#5 [collect Action]
血缘节点总数 = 5
构建 5 个 RDD 谱系，但全程未触发一次数据计算（惰性）
code:
class RDD:
    _seq = 0
    def __init__(self, deps, op):
        RDD._seq += 1
        self.rid = RDD._seq
        self.deps = deps
        self.op = op
    def show(self, prefix=""):
        for d in self.deps:
            d.show(prefix + "  ")
        print(f"{prefix}RDD#{self.rid} [{self.op}]")

base = RDD([], "parallelize 分区=4")
m    = RDD([base], "map x=>x*2")
f    = RDD([m], "filter x%2==0")
g    = RDD([f], "reduceByKey 宽依赖")
out  = RDD([g], "collect Action")
print("血缘 DAG（自下而上，缩进=父级依赖）:")
out.show()
print("血缘节点总数 =", RDD._seq)
print("构建", RDD._seq, "个 RDD 谱系，但全程未触发一次数据计算（惰性）")
